mechanism: Posaconazole is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that increases valbenazine and its active metabolite (NBI-98854) plasma concentrations, elevating risk of QT prolongation and adverse effects.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; consider dose reduction of valbenazine or use alternative antifungal; avoid combination if possible due to NTI status of valbenazine.
